name: Bethzur
overview: Bethzur is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Maon according to 1 Chronicles 2:45. There are no additional notes or detailed narratives about his life or role in Scripture. His mention is brief and genealogical, situating him within the lineage of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Bethzur is a proper name meaning 'cliff house' in Hebrew. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God but reflects a descriptive or locational designation common in biblical naming practices.
familyAndRelationships: Bethzur is recorded as the son of Maon, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not provide further family details or other relational connections beyond this father-son link.
scriptureSignificance: Bethzur's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, which is central to the Messianic lineage. Though the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal deeds or character, his inclusion in the genealogies underscores the providential preservation of the family line through which God's redemptive plan unfolds. This brief mention contributes to the broader biblical narrative emphasizing God's faithfulness to His covenant people.
